description: This file declares classes and methods related to container management, specifically for 'CRunContainer' and its administrator 'CRunContainerAdministrator'. It includes class definitions, method signatures, and external dependencies for container operations within the Thunder::ProcessContainers namespace.

classes.name: CRunContainer
classes.description: Represents a container managed via the crun library, providing methods to start, stop, and retrieve information about the container.

classes.name: CRunContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Manages multiple CRunContainer instances, providing methods to create, retrieve, and configure containers.

methods.name: CRunContainer
methods.description: Constructor initializing a container with specified name, path, and log path.

methods.name: ~CRunContainer
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up container resources.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the container.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID of the container.

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container with a specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, with a specified timeout.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Retrieves memory information of the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Retrieves processor information of the container.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves network interface information of the container.

methods.name: ClearLeftovers
methods.description: Private method to clear residual container data.

methods.name: OverwriteContainerArgs
methods.description: Private method to modify container arguments.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container based on ID, search paths, log path, and configuration.

methods.name: Logging
methods.description: Configures logging options for container management.
